mentions.name: World Cup prediction model
mentions.description: A World Cup prediction model built to compete in a prediction league, using a Poisson distribution model combined with Monte Carlo simulations to forecast outcomes. The accompanying write-up explains the process and maths with inline SVG charts (no chart library), and future work explores whether a Dixon-Coles low-scoring correction would have changed the results.
mentions.problem: The author's team competes in a World Cup prediction league, but the author doesn't know much about football teams, so they built a statistical model to try to top the league charts.
mentions.audience: The author's team competes in a World Cup prediction league, but the author doesn't know much about football teams, so they built a statistical model to try to top the league charts.
mentions.source_excerpt: figured I’d build a prediction model to try and top the charts. Uses a Poisson distribution model and Monte Carlo simulations. I wrote up the process and the maths as well as generated some inline SVGs (no chart library).
